name: examined-design
description: A method and a harness for designing with an AI model: a single-file prototype edited one patch at a time, a build that refuses when a link lies, thirteen checks that refute and say what they cannot see, decision rounds with the case for every option, and a backlog whose strings trace to boards. Eleven stage skills follow the loop of the paper Examined Design, with an entry point, the harness contract, drift, backlog and a standalone Jira planner.
